label: Plesk portfolio migration connector
summary: Prepare a selected Plesk export integration for explicit resource mapping and staged migration planning.
core_boundary: The connector does not convert every extension, permission model or web-server directive automatically; Core retains destination admission. This is a design-only connector proposal. Essential hosting, current actor and tenant authorization, native service drivers and recovery remain in the free Core. No production interface, publisher trust, installation or effectful capability is established by this metadata.
acceptance: Pin source export and product profiles and record all supported objects, excluded data and incompatible extension settings.
Validate archive paths, tenant boundaries, object ownership and secret-reference handling before destination import plans.
Exercise repeatable staging, delta reconciliation and explicit cutover/rollback with source data retained until a separate purge decision.

Before implementation, qualify an explicitly selected provider/interface revision, supported compatibility matrix, immutable package provenance, dependency inventory and licensing model; no release is admitted by this proposal.

Enforce current Core actor, tenant and capability checks at each admitted request; keep credentials in scoped secret references, redact diagnostics and reject arbitrary destinations, shell commands or host/container sockets.

Demonstrate that disablement, removal, provider outage and commercial entitlement loss preserve essential Core access, hosted workloads, local audit and recovery; retain owned data unless a separately authorized purge is requested.
